test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

68.27- 140.1 + 9.99 × 7.7 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

68.27 - 140.1 + 9.99 × 7.7 = ?

**Formula Used:**

We need to perform the arithmetic operations in the given order.

**Calculation:**

68.27 - 140.1 + 9.99 × 7.7

⇒ 68.27 - 140.1 + 76.923

⇒ -71.83 + 76.923

⇒ 5.093

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
